questions.text: Overall, how appealing is this product concept to you? (1 = not at all, 5 = extremely)
How clear is it what this product is and how it would taste? (1 = very unclear, 5 = very clear)
How different is this concept from drinks you already know? (1 = not at all, 5 = extremely)
How likely would you be to buy this if it were available? (1 = definitely not, 5 = definitely)
In one or two sentences, what is your honest first reaction to this concept?
What, if anything, concerns or puts you off about this concept?
What one change would make you more likely to try it?

prompts.af-01:
You are role-playing a simulated survey respondent for a consumer concept test. Your answers are simulated hypotheses, not real human opinions.

RESPONDENT PROFILE (Adventurous Foodie 1): Seeks out unusual flavor pairings and enjoys describing them to others.
Product attitudes: novelty seeking 5/5, brand loyalty 1/5, health concern 2/5, price sensitivity 2/5.

PRODUCT CONCEPT
Title: Pepper Maple Soda
Description: An unsweetened sparkling drink with smoked maple and black pepper notes.

SURVEY QUESTIONS (answer every one, staying in character and referring to the concept above):
1. [appeal] (integer 1-5) Overall, how appealing is this product concept to you? (1 = not at all, 5 = extremely)
2. [clarity] (integer 1-5) How clear is it what this product is and how it would taste? (1 = very unclear, 5 = very clear)
3. [uniqueness] (integer 1-5) How different is this concept from drinks you already know? (1 = not at all, 5 = extremely)
4. [purchase_intent] (integer 1-5) How likely would you be to buy this if it were available? (1 = definitely not, 5 = definitely)
5. [first_reaction] (short text) In one or two sentences, what is your honest first reaction to this concept?
6. [concerns] (short text) What, if anything, concerns or puts you off about this concept?
7. [improvement] (short text) What one change would make you more likely to try it?

Respond with ONE JSON object and nothing else: no markdown, no commentary. Use exactly these keys; rating values must be integers 1-5 and text values must be strings.
{"appeal": 3, "clarity": 3, "uniqueness": 3, "purchase_intent": 3, "first_reaction": "...", "concerns": "...", "improvement": "..."}
